primary_metric: number of build scenarios with both a native-success and native-failure episode whose recorded prefixes replay identically
falsification: Zero mixed-outcome scenarios rejects the sufficiency of this source protocol; any native success alone is not contract efficacy or an admitted bank
selection_note: Same training scenarios, prompts, fixed team, seed schedule and action limits as cycle08. Only backend and declared monetary/price caps change. Reserved partitions remain unopened; oracle scenario excluded.
interpretation: Prospective stronger-coding-backend diagnostic, not a published baseline reproduction, causal model-size experiment, or learned-memory comparison. Record every outcome, failure and cost; no route/model/task substitution.
